title: Pitch, octave, and pitch class
description: Lesson 1 review. Flip, then mark Again or Known.

cards.back: How high or low a sound is.
The distance from a pitch to the next matching “same note” above or below it. The higher pitch vibrates twice as fast.
The name shared by all pitches an octave apart. Every A in every octave is pitch class A.

cards.front: Open low E and the 12th fret on that string: same pitch, or same pitch class?
cards.back: Same pitch class (E), different pitches — one octave apart.

cards.front: Why do scales and chords use pitch classes?
cards.back: They are built from a small set of names. Octaves only place those classes higher or lower on the instrument.

cards.front: Open low E and open high E: same pitch class?
cards.back: Yes — both are E. Different octaves, so different pitches.
